description: A game's read-only share links to its boards: for a dev log, Discord, a publisher, or a game's own "Live stats" link. With page: makes one to that board page, which anyone with it sees, and nothing else, signed out; no expiry unless days is set; sums (revenue, totals) show only with sums: true; the link is shown once. With revoke: that link stops working at once, for everyone who has it. With neither: lists them, with the page each shows, when it expires, when it was last opened (to about ten minutes) and whether it's revoked. Ask the person before making or revoking one.

days.description: With page: expire after 1, 7, 30, 90 or 365 days

game.description: The game, by name or id, when signed in to a workspace (glitchless_list_games lists them); later calls keep it. With a key for one game (gl_sk_…), a call that names another game is refused: sign in to the workspace to reach every game.

name.description: With page: what the link is for, e.g. "Dev log"

page.description: Make a link to this board page (glitchless_dashboard lists their ids)

revoke.description: Revoke the link with this id (from the list)

service.description: With page: the game's service (default: its most recently active one)

sums.description: With page: show sums such as revenue

name: glitchless_share_links
title: Share links
